simple.meaning: מְחִידָא (Mᵉchîydâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Mechida , one of the Nethinim.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מְחִידָא (H4240) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:52, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְחִידָא (H4240) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מְחִידָא (H4240) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מְחִידָא (Mᵉchîydâʼ) / H4240 is traced through Ezra 2:52, Nehemiah 7:54 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4240. Mechida מְחִידָא proper name, masculine head of a family of returning exiles Ezra 2:52 ( ᵐ5 Μαουδα ᵐ5 L Μεειδα ) = Neh 7:54 ( ᵐ5 Μεειδα ). מִחְיָה see חיה . מְחַיָּיאֵל see מְחוּיָאֵל .
